purpose: 阿比尼西亚猫四张独立 3D 建模参考图
style: 红棕色（ruddy）成年阿比尼西亚猫，写实风格，白底，四足中性站姿，正交视图意图
notes: 左、右以猫自身的解剖学方向命名：左视图猫头朝画面左侧，右视图猫头朝画面右侧。
侧视图采用两侧腿重叠的中性站姿，远侧腿因遮挡不单独露出。
四张图片独立生成，尺寸相同，细节及垂直比例存在少量差异。导入 Blender 后先对齐脚底基线，再以耳尖、肩部、髋部复核缩放；不要把这些概念参考当作精密测量图。
尾巴在前后视图中存在正常的遮挡和投影缩短。
旧版三视图保留；本次没有修改 Blender 模型。

prompts.left:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single full-body orthographic character reference image for 3D modeling, one of a matched four-view set.
Input image 1 is the existing ruddy Abyssinian cat design reference (three-view sheet). Input image 2 is its top view, used only to understand body width and coat. Preserve the same individual cat's lean proportions, elegant wedge head, very large upright ears, almond-shaped amber-gold eyes, warm ruddy copper agouti-ticked short coat, darker spine and black tail tip. Re-generate as a clean professional realistic 3D sculpting reference, one cat, not a collage.
Requested view: STRICT LEFT SIDE / LEFT LATERAL ORTHOGRAPHIC, showing the cat's own anatomical LEFT flank; nose points toward the LEFT edge of the image, tail toward RIGHT. Camera at exactly 90 degrees to body axis, level, no perspective, no 3/4 or elevated view. Head faces along the body, no head turn.
Pose to lock for all four views: adult cat standing calmly with four paws planted, bilateral symmetric neutral stance (no staggered walking feet), shoulders relaxed, front legs vertical, feline digitigrade hind legs with realistic knees and hocks. Spine gently natural, belly lightly tucked, chest slender, neck upright but relaxed, mouth closed. Long tapered tail follows the body centerline straight backward from the pelvis and slopes gently downward, no lateral curl; tail tip stays above the floor. Two near-side legs visible clearly; opposite-side legs naturally superimposed with only slight silhouette separation, do not invent a walking stride.
Canvas: landscape 3:2, ideally 1536 x 1024, generous clean margins. Full cat including ears, all paws and complete tail visible. Paw contact horizontal baseline near 89% canvas height; tallest ear tip near 12% canvas height. Center the entire full-body silhouette horizontally. Maintain this vertical scale for subsequent views.
Style: anatomically credible high-detail reference render, smooth evenly lit fur that reveals underlying volumes, modest fine whiskers, neutral studio illumination, crisp contours. Uniform pure white background, almost no ground shadow, no horizon, no dramatic shading, no text, labels, grids, borders, props, accessories, collar or watermark.
Coat: fine agouti ticking only, no broad tabby stripes, no white socks or bib, no decorative patches. Natural small pale chin only. Natural adult athletic Abyssinian, not chubby, not kitten, not caricature. No exposed skeleton or muscles. Output ONLY the single left lateral image.
prompts.left_correction:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied single left orthographic Abyssinian reference. Preserve this exact cat, coat, head, ears, torso, scale, white background, image dimensions, tail and ground baseline. Change ONLY the limb stance to a bilateral symmetrical neutral rigging stance, correcting the current fore-aft stagger of the opposite hind leg.
Make the far hind leg anatomically superimpose behind the near hind leg: both left and right hip joints at the same body-axis station, both knees at the same station and height, both hocks at the same station and height, and both hind paw contacts at the same body-axis station. In this strict lateral orthographic projection the far hind limb must be occluded behind the near limb; remove its currently separate forward-shifted paw and shin. Do the same for forelimbs so the far foreleg is directly behind the near foreleg and occluded, no staggered toes. The result should show TWO clear limb silhouettes (one forelimb, one digitigrade hind limb); the cat still has four legs but the other two are hidden by orthographic superposition. Preserve the current near front paw and near hind paw locations, correct anatomy, no duplicated limbs or extra protrusions. No camera rotation, no head turn, no new objects or labels. Output only the corrected single left side view, nose pointing left.
prompts.front:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one individual full-body orthographic Abyssinian reference image for 3D modeling.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED MASTER LEFT VIEW: use its exact cat proportions, anatomy, neutral standing pose, coat, tail position, scale and lighting. Input image 2 is the previous three-view design sheet: use only to support facial identity and widths, NOT its staggered legs or curved sideward tail. Output a NEW single view, not a sheet.
Preserve the same adult ruddy Abyssinian: lean athletic torso, tucked belly, long graceful legs with feline digitigrade hind joints, long upright neck, small elegant wedge head, large upright ears, amber-gold eyes, copper-brown short agouti ticked fur, darker dorsal fur, darker paws, tapered black-tipped tail, tiny natural pale chin. No broad stripes, white socks or bib.
Pose: FOUR planted paws, bilateral symmetrical neutral stance, paired front joints/paws at identical longitudinal stations, paired hind joints/paws at identical stations. No walking stride. Spine level and gently natural. Head faces exactly along the body axis, mouth closed. Tail remains in the median sagittal plane, projecting backward and sloping gently down as in master, no lateral curl. Only change the camera direction; do not change pose, length, breed, body thickness or age.
Rendering: strict orthographic projection, level camera, no perspective shortening of vertical dimensions, no 3/4 view, no camera tilt. Realistic high-detail model reference render, clean crisp silhouette, fine short fur, even neutral light to show volumes.
Canvas must match MASTER: landscape 3:2 at 1536x1024. Ear tips near y=72 (7% canvas height), paws touch at y=910 (89% canvas height). Preserve body height and all vertical landmark heights. Center the cat's midline horizontally at x=768. Complete head, ears, paws and tail visible where projection permits; generous side whitespace for front/back instead of enlarging the cat.
Uniform pure white background, very subtle contact shadow only. No labels, borders, grids, accessories, collar, text, props or watermark. Only one cat.
Requested view: EXACT FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC. Camera directly in front of the cat looking along its sagittal axis from nose toward tail. The face looks straight at camera, both eyes, both ear interiors, nose, chest and front paws symmetrical. Forelimbs are slightly narrower than hindlimbs; show the hind paws behind and just outboard of front paws only if naturally visible. Do not draw hind paws below the ground or shift legs forward. Face amber eyes at the master's corresponding height (about y=210-220), chin about y=290. Ear span about 310 pixels and chest width about 240 pixels, slender breed. Tail behind the body, hidden wherever occluded, no tail sweeping sideways. Produce only FRONT image.

prompts.front_alignment:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the FRONT VIEW edit target. Image 2 is the approved LEFT VIEW for scale alignment only.
Preserve image 1's exact frontal cat, identity, shape, pose, coat, lighting, white background, symmetry and orthographic camera. Correct only its uniform framing/scale: make the cat figure about 7.3% smaller, without changing proportions, so its tallest ear tip aligns to image 2 at y=72 and its front paw soles align to image 2 at y=910 on the SAME 1536x1024 landscape canvas. The cat centerline stays at x=768. Maintain generous blank white space left and right. Both rear paws must touch the same projected ground row as front paws under true orthographic projection, and may be naturally occluded/outboard. Do not restyle or re-pose the cat or add anything. No text, labels, borders or grids. Output ONLY the aligned front image.
prompts.back_alignment:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the BACK VIEW edit target. Image 2 is the approved LEFT VIEW for scale alignment only.
Preserve image 1's exact rear-facing cat, identity, silhouette, neutral symmetric stance, coat, tail on the centerline, lighting, white background and strict rear camera. Correct only its uniform framing: shrink the cat figure approximately 5.5% on the unchanged 1536x1024 landscape canvas so the tallest ear tips align with image 2 near y=72 and the hind paw soles align with image 2 near y=910. Keep midline centered x=768. Preserve proportions and full body. Backs of ears and back of head only, no face turning or eyes visible. Tail stays in the sagittal plane with black tip near y=720, viewed foreshortened. Both front and rear paws touch one horizontal projected floor line under orthographic projection wherever visible. No text, labels, grids, borders or objects. Output only the aligned BACK image.
